notes.title: Update 0.12
notes.notes: [p]Hello again, got some more bug-fixes and patches for you all[/p][p][/p][p][b]Main game[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Hard map![/b] GOBLIN MODE. (Easier maps coming soon)[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution, aspect ratio and window type settings should now work correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution option is now unavailable while window is set to Borderless, as it does nothing due to the window being locked to your screen resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]The song menu can now be navigated with a mouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Framerate and keybind settings are now saved and applied properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where quitting out of a level too fast caused the level to keep playing in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the number dimming option did not work properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Default maps will now be always automatically added at startup if they are not present.[/p][/*][*][p]The map content cards now fit names better and scale size.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reduced memory usage.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Map Editor[/b][/p][list][*][p]Dragging the top progress bar while playing the track now properly pauses the editor before moving with it.[/p][/*][*][p]The top bar's hitbox is now properly set.[/p][/*][*][p]The difficulty option in the editor now has set default difficulty options with a optional Custom Difficulty name (if you want to be fancy).[/p][/*][*][p]Approach rate is now loaded properly into the settings when opening a song.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled the hitsound volume bar in the editor as it is not functional yet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where opening a map in the editor would result in the editor softlocking if the map did not have any notes. Also applies to making a new map.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved all text fields to be less annoying to select.[/p][/*][/list][p]Stay tuned for more![/p][p][/p][p]ps. we're aiming to add at least 1 map/difficulty with every update from here on out, so more content for you all.[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.11
notes.notes: [p][b]Main Game fixes[/b][/p][p]+ Fixed Rebinding to work again[/p][p]+ Added a button to reset your keybinds to the defaults[/p][p]+ Added resolution, aspect ratio and window type options[/p][p][/p][p][b]Editor Fixes[/b][/p][p]+ Added the ability to scroll in the map editor by dragging the top progress bar[/p][p]+ The Difficulty is now loaded when opening the editor[/p][p]+ Fixed a bug that wiped out the timeline when changing certain options in the editor[/p][p]+ Notes can no longer be placed under anything in the editor[/p][p][/p][p]Ps: The version has a .1 because some fool completely broke the map editor and forgot to test it, then uploaded that as the launch version (It was me)[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1
notes.notes: [h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Added a simple placeholder hit sound, a better one will be added later. [/p][/*][*][p]Added the prestigious P-rank, rewarded for completing a song perfectly (full combo, all notes hit perfect)[/p][/*][/list][p]Known Issues:[/p][list][*][p]Clicking buttons on the left side of the screen is blocked when in the song menu[/p][/*][*][p]The song title cards can't fit longer mapper/user names.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Map Editor[/h3][p][/p][h3]Fixed Bugs:[/h3][list][*][p]Opening a pre-existing map from the main menu to the editor now works the first time rather than the second.[/p][/*][*][p]Opening a map from the main menu now always should open the [i]correct map[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Changing notes per beat no longer resets your entire entire map.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved map loading performance[/p][/*][/list][p]Known bugs:[/p][list][*][p]When clicking to place a note, it is slightly off vertically, this will be fixed in the next patch[/p][/*][*][p]Opening a song from the main menu to the editor does not automatically load the difficulty name[/p][/*][/list]
